name: Night and winter
description: Snowy villages, frosty mornings, moonlit rivers and winter dusks, chosen to stay light enough to read a dashboard over.

works.alt_text: A Norwegian village under deep snow, with houses touched with red, a small arched bridge and frosted birch trees below a blue wooded hill.
A frosted valley in pale blues and pinks, with autumn trees in red and gold and two small figures walking along a path.
A woodblock print of a snowy riverbank with pines, stone lanterns and a gate, a deep blue river and white hills beyond under falling snow.
Two snow-covered stacks of wheat in a field glowing violet and blue under an orange and pink sunset sky.
A winding river with ice floes between snowy banks, bare trees and a farmhouse in low golden winter sunlight.
A woodblock print of a village at night under heavy snow, with travellers holding hats and umbrellas walking up a white slope.
A waterfall tumbling through snow-covered rocks, with pink mill buildings on the bank and wooded blue hills behind.
A stylised print of grey plovers flying over a teal river that curves between white banks of snow-laden reeds.
A French village street after snowfall, with tall pale houses, bare trees and a snowy hillside rising behind.
A blue and white woodblock print of a riverside village and pine trees under snow, a small boat on the pale water below.
A colour print of tall green-trunked beech trees in a snowy wood, with two people carrying bundles of firewood on the right.
A woodblock print of boats on a broad river under a full moon, a castle with tiled roofs on the right and pale fields beyond.
A winter marsh at sunset, with a red sun low behind dark bushes, a band of glowing cloud and a river edged with snow.
A photograph of a small white house deep in fresh snow, with a pole in front, frosted trees and a wooded hill behind.
A woodblock print of a ferry crowded with passengers in straw hats crossing a deep blue river, with snowy pines and houses on the far bank.
A crowd of skaters in bright winter coats on a frozen pond, with dark blue wooded hills and a snowy slope behind.
A pen and wash drawing of a Dutch village in winter, with bare trees, cottages, a church spire and a skater by a small arched bridge.
A large silver moon rising behind tall white and black grasses against a soft grey sky.
Snow-capped Alpine peaks above a dark green valley and lake, with goats and a resting herder on the grassy slope in front.
A woodblock print of a ferry with passengers crossing a blue river at dusk, a long wooden bridge and the dark cone of Mount Fuji beyond.
A photograph of a snowy path through a winter field, with bare trees and low hills under a pale grey sky.
A pencil drawing of a white snow-covered building with a small bell tower and a signpost in a snowstorm, with bare trees on a pale hillside.
A pale print of a barge being towed along a snowy riverbank, with willows heavy with snow and white hills behind.
A black and white photograph of snowy, glacier-covered mountains beneath a sky of small rippled clouds.
